name: TurtleTracerLib
description: Pedro Pathing add-on for running paths planned in Turtle Tracer, with path events and command-based path following.

versions.notes: The README builds it against Pedro Pathing 3.0.1.

postInstall: Plan your paths in Turtle Tracer (https://github.com/Mallen220/TurtleTracer/releases), then export Java code or a .turt file to use with TurtleTracerReader.

requires.reason: TurtleTracerLib is built on Pedro Pathing and does not bring it in.

verification.notes: Published through JitPack from the repository's tags; the README also suggests master-SNAPSHOT, which FTC Core does not offer. The library's POM lists no dependencies, so Pedro Pathing has to be installed separately.
